project_title: Redesign UI/UX Dashboard People Counter (CCTV Repo)

core_principles: Light, clean, modern, and high contrast for effortless readability
Subtle white glassmorphism (78-90% opacity with soft border & soft backdrop blur)
Honest data state: explicit stale data labels, error handling with retry, and zero vs pending distinctions
No global dark theme, no neon gradients, no heavy shadows, no nested cards, no upper-cased labels

app_shell.desktop: Flex layout with ~72px charcoal vertical rail on left (#18181B), main content area on right with #F3F4F6 background and 24-32px padding
app_shell.mobile: Top header with brand mark + drawer button for compact navigation

sidebar_rail.background: bg-zinc-900 text-white flex flex-col items-center py-6 h-screen sticky top-0

header_bar.title: Ringkasan pengunjung
header_bar.subtitle: Pantau lalu lintas orang masuk dan keluar toko secara terkini
controls: Store Selector (Dropdown with search / clear selection state)
Date Navigation (Prev button, Date picker, Next button, 'Hari ini' quick button)
Perbarui (Refresh button with manual spinner state)
Metadata panel: Timezone toko (e.g. WIB / Asia/Jakarta) + Waktu pembaruan ringkas

kpi_cards.title: Orang masuk
kpi_cards.description: Jumlah total pengunjung masuk pada periode terpilih

kpi_cards.title: Orang keluar
kpi_cards.description: Jumlah total pengunjung keluar pada periode terpilih

kpi_cards.title: Selisih masuk–keluar
kpi_cards.description: Total masuk dikurangi total keluar pada tanggal ini

kpi_cards.title: Event terakhir
kpi_cards.description: Waktu terdeteksi aktivitas kamera atau perangkat CCTV

hourly_chart.title: Kunjungan per jam
features: Custom Tooltip with precise values and formatted hour range
Explicit distinction between zero count vs missing/unregistered data
Responsive X-Axis tick label spacing on smaller viewports

device_status_list.title: Aktivitas Perangkat & Kamera
device_status_list.rules: Hapus prefiks API key atau kredensial teknis, jangan gunakan sebutan 'Live/Online'.

states_and_feedback.skeleton_loading: Matching component geometry (card skeletons, chart bar skeleton, table row skeletons) with subtle pulse animation
states_and_feedback.refreshing: Maintain existing rendered data while showing top inline banner 'Memperbarui data...' + spin indicator
states_and_feedback.stale_data_warning: Yellow subtle banner if refresh fails: 'Menampilkan data terakhir (gagal memperbarui)' with Retry CTA button
states_and_feedback.empty_state: Clean illustration icon + title 'Belum ada data kunjungan' + helpful suggestion text
states_and_feedback.error_state: Red soft container + 'Gagal memuat data' + 'Coba lagi' button

accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_nav: Full tab ordering, visible focus ring offset-2 focus:ring-emerald-600 focus:outline-none
accessibility_and_testing.touch_target: Minimum 44px x 44px for buttons and form toggles

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components consume the specified design tokens strictly: #F3F4F6 background, #FFFFFF main surface, charcoal rail #18181B, dark emerald #047857.
Use lucide-react icons for navigation and actions.
Use Recharts for the grouped bar chart with responsive design.
Do NOT apply full dark theme or neon gradients under any circumstances.
Keep standard Bahasa Indonesia labels throughout the entire interface.
All interactive elements must include explicit data-testid attributes for testing.
